from pathlib import Path

 (\" ali \", \" Ali \"), (\" maula\", \" Maula\"), (\"Maula haye\", \"Maula, haye\"),
 (\"masjid e kufa\", \"masjid-e-Kufa\"), (\"Hae \", \"Haye \"),
 (\"aa mera aaqa\", \"aa mere aaqa\"), (\"Khaalik\", \"Khaaliq\"),
 (\" rab \", \" Rab \"), (\"bu-turaab\", \"Bu Turaab\"), (\"meiṅ\", \"mein\"),
 (\"Aansu \", \"Aansuṅ \"), (\"rahe hai nabi\", \"rahe haiṅ Nabi\"),
 (\"has ke mari\", \"hans ke maari\"), (\"bezameer\", \"bezamir\"),
 (\"hogaya\", \"ho gaya\"), (\"sare shaahe la fata\", \"sar-e-Shaah-e-La Fata\"),
 (\"hote hai beqarar\", \"hote haiṅ beqaraar\"),
 (\"tarapte hai rote hai\", \"tarapte haiṅ rote haiṅ\"), (\"dunya\", \"duniya\"),
 (\"Hyder\", \"Haidar\"), (\"hasnain uthaye\", \"Hasnain uthaaye\"),
